send.title: Send it through Comeet
send.body: Comeet can deliver this resume (as a PDF) and your letter straight to the application inbox at {{company}}.
send.confirmBody: We'll send the resume above (as a PDF) and your cover letter straight to the application inbox at {{company}} through Comeet — the same place their own Apply button delivers to. This is a real application and can't be undone.
send.note: Sending works only for Comeet postings whose draft has no claims to check. It's capped per day, never applies twice to the same company, and never touches LinkedIn.

refused.kit_not_found: This draft no longer exists. Reload the page.
refused.not_approved: Only a draft you approved can be sent.
refused.kit_flagged: This draft has claims to check, so it is never sent from here, even after approval.
refused.not_comeet: Sending from here works only for Comeet postings. Apply to this one on its board.
refused.not_comeet_url: This job's link is not a Comeet position page, so it can't be sent from here.
refused.recaptcha: {{company}} protects this position with a bot check, so it can't be sent from here. Use the extension's assisted apply, or apply on the Comeet page.
refused.company_already_sent: You already sent an application to {{company}} from here, and it is one per company. Apply to their other openings on their own page.
refused.application_missing: The approved draft for this job is missing. Approve it again.
refused.draft_changed: The resume on this job changed after you approved it (a new tailor, or lines you typed), so it has no clean claims check to send on. Apply on the Comeet page, or with the extension's assisted apply.
refused.resume_unreadable: The approved resume can't be read. Approve the draft again.
refused.contact_missing: Your resume needs a name and an email address before it can be sent. Fill in the contact line, then approve it again.
refused.careers_unreachable: Couldn't reach the Comeet careers page of {{company}}. Try again in a minute.
refused.comeet_locked: {{company}} locked this application against sending from here (usually a bot check, or the position just closed). Use the extension's assisted apply, or apply on Comeet.
refused.comeet_declined: Comeet turned the application down (error {{status}}). Apply on the Comeet page instead.
refused.comeet_unreachable: Couldn't reach Comeet to send the application. Try again.
